messages:
Carmen: received multiple customer escalations about 502/504s hitting hosted API around 11:02-11:08 UTC. Spike seems concentrated on tenant 'acme-inc' during large /embeddings batch calls (size ~500).
Alice: seeing same in prod graphs — frontdoor edge svc shows a short surge of 502s, tailing off at ~11:09. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/edge/502s (repro link).
IncidentBot: Alert: edge-gateway error-rate (502) > 5% for tenant acme-inc between 2025-10-12T11:01:30Z and 2025-10-12T11:09:00Z.
Dennis: any deploys or config changes around that time?
Ben: nothing in deploy history for edge or auth prox in last 6 hours. DeployBot: no deploys to edge in last 24h.
Eva: quick triage — traces show upstream pool exhaustion logs on Envoy when client stream opens many parallel connections, then upstream resets with "socket: connection reset by peer". Small sample from trace: ```envoy upstream healthcheck: connpool_exhausted -> reset by upstream: ECONNRESET```
Alice: also correlated with a spike in tenant token rotation traffic — many short-lived auth requests to billing/auth service then back to edge. Could be keepalive/window churn.
Carmen: customer sent curl repro that reproduces 502s for them: ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @payload.json & done; wait``` They run a burst of parallel requests.
Dennis: hypothesis: keepalive/window mismatch + auth rotation causes upstreams to tear connections; Envoy hits connection window/circuit limits and responds 502 to clients. Could be h2 stream allocation exhaustion.
Ben: mitigation idea: temporarily reduce max parallel connections per tenant at frontdoor (rate cap) and enable auth caching fallback to avoid rotation storm. Also increase upstream_conn_pool_size for affected edge cluster as short-term.
Eva: logs show auth service returning 200 but with slightly longer latencies (200-400ms) during spike -> more concurrent connections pile up. I can put a temporary token caching rule to reduce auth backend calls for 5m.
Alice: ACTIONS: @Dennis to push ratecap change (tenant cap 50 -> 20) to frontdoor; @Eva to enable short auth-cache bypass throttle; @Ben to open infra ticket to bump Envoy upstream pool size and investigate h2 windowing. I'll notify customer with rollback plan.
Carmen: customer update draft: "We're seeing a transient edge gateway issue during a burst of large embedding batches; we're applying throttling and cache mitigations now — will follow up when stable." :thumbsup:
Dennis: applied ratecap change and reloaded frontdoor config at 11:12 UTC, monitoring.
IncidentBot: Update: error-rate dropped below threshold at 11:16 UTC.
Ben: created infra ticket #INF-2839 with initial findings + traces + suggested kernel/Envoy tunables.
Eva: follow-up: need longer-term fix — suggest smarter batching guidance (split huge embedding batches), guardrails in SDK to quorum backoff on auth rotation, and tune keepalive + h2 settings in edge.
Alice: assigning follow-ups: INF-2839 -> Ben, SDK-backoff proposal -> Carmen + Alice, postmortem -> Dennis.
Carmen: closing thread for now, will convert to postmortem if recurrence. Thanks everyone.
